integrity: Analytical proof with reproducible finite numerical checks; self-review only, no independent audit. The 2006-12-15 date is the Friday public conference-session date documented by the cited dated proceedings, not a claim about an earlier preprint or electronic posting. The original 2003 related paper has a year-level print date but no verified day-resolved original release date.
scientific_limitations: Characterizes exactly the conductance thresholds and all equality placements attaining the rank-one spectral ceiling on unit-weight paths; it does not classify best locations below the saturation threshold, unequal base conductances, or multiple added links. A plausible 2003 fixed-girth unicyclic optimization paper was not accessible in full, posing residual originality risk.
title: Sharp conductance and placement thresholds for path shortcuts
